title: Verify: Suggest button opens the contribution dialog unit tests
summary: Unit tests cover the header button callback and the App dialog opening.
description: Component test for HeaderOverlay plus App test with api client and Phaser mocked.
acceptance_criteria: App opens the dialog from the header button and renders exactly one such button.
Focus returns to the header button on Escape.
technical_constraints: Mock ../src/api/client getCurrentRound and listMine; mock phaser, createGame, BootScene and ResizeObserver exactly as tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx does.

steps.action: Create test 'clicking the suggest button calls onSuggest once': render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle="W" round={roundFixture} onSuggest={fn} /> with fn = vi.fn(); fireEvent.click(getByRole('button',{name:'Suggest What Happens Next'})); expect fn toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); expect button text content '+ SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT' and class sf-btn-gold. roundFixture from tests/fixtures/api.ts (mirrors backend Round JSON).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerSuggest.test.tsx

steps.action: Copy the mocks from tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx L1-L38. Add test: render App, click Begin, await getCurrentRound, expect getAllByRole('button',{name:'Suggest What Happens Next'}) length 1 and it is inside getByRole('banner'); click it; expect getByRole('dialog') toBeInTheDocument(). Add test: press Escape (fireEvent.keyDown on dialog, key Escape) and waitFor document.activeElement equals the button.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx
steps.expected: New and existing focus tests pass.
